title: Thrust Control Quadrant Friction Damper and Resolver Mounting Rework

issue.reason: Issue B. Earlier issues are not held in this dataset.

abstract: A serviceable friction damper and a stiffer resolver mounting for the thrust control quadrant, ending the lever creep that crews were correcting by hand on long sectors.

sections.reason: Crews reported thrust levers creeping back by up to two degrees over a cruise sector on aircraft above about twenty thousand flight hours, which they correct by hand and which is not a safety issue but is a persistent irritation and a recurring pilot report. Removed quadrants showed the friction pack bedded in and no longer adjustable within the range the manual gives, and in four cases the resolver mounting bracket had fretted at its attachment so that the sensed lever angle lagged the actual one by half a degree.
sections.description: The friction damper is made serviceable on wing: the cowl latch HED768198-70 is replaced by an access item that lets the pack be re-shimmed without removing the quadrant, and the shroud kit INDE893867-87 is re-profiled to clear the new latch. The resolver bracket is stiffened and its attachment is changed from two fasteners to four, and the seal VAL944782-67 at the quadrant base is renewed because the base is disturbed. The protective sleeve LN938888K1 is added over the resolver tail, and countersunk screws LN727699-25 are used at the bracket. Heat shield 10EC and its upper counterpart 83EC are refitted; bracket 76EC is replaced. Work is at the pedestal and in the pylon interface areas of zones 413, 432 and 433. Detail is on drawings D76101238743 and D76101264759.
sections.effects: Mass increase of 1.6 kg. No electrical load change. The quadrant is one-way interchangeable: a post-modification quadrant may be fitted to a pre-modification aircraft but not the other way round, because the access latch requires the reworked shroud. The friction check moves from a shop task to a line task and the quadrant removal interval doubles. The adjustment procedure is new and the tooling list changes.
sections.embodiment_note: Production cut-in at MSN S01493. Retrofit is twenty-four manhours with the pedestal opened, offered at an A-check. The friction pack is a consumable at retrofit and is not returned.

type_data.balance_impact: Forward of the reference datum; negligible
